text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of summer camp.
It's a
period of intense training where
racers can
improve their skills.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
More than two months have passed since
the
Yayoi Sho, yet Сайленс Судзука still
seems unable
to shake her doubts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: This summer... I have to get faster...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(But my legs are feeling heavier and
heavier.)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
And so, summer camp with Silence
Suzuka begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
